messages:
sophie: Hey team — customer (Acme Logistics) report: invoice #INV-2026-042 failed when charging their company card. They say card works elsewhere. Last4=4321.

sophie: Error we return: 402 Payment Required, body: `{\"error\":{\"type\":\"card_error\",\"code\":\"card_declined\",\"decline_code\":\"do_not_honor\",\"message\":\"The card was declined.\"}}`

anna-support: Thanks — any attached bank response in logs? If not I can ask the customer to share a bank screenshot.

sophie: I pulled the billing gateway logs: `gateway_charge_id=gtw_1Hk9...` and the acquirer response is `DO_NOT_HONOR`. No AVS mismatch. Currency USD. Attempt timestamp 2026-02-18T14:22:14Z.

jamie-payments: Can you repro via our staging billing endpoint? Send a curl with the same payload and masked card. If staging returns the same decline code it points to network/acquirer.

sophie: Repro steps I used (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://billing.staging.redwood.ai/charges \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-042","amount":12500,"currency":"USD","card":{"number":"4000000000000002","exp_month":12,"exp_year":2026,"cvc":"123"}}'
```
Response: 402 + same decline body. I tried with our reserve gateway key and got identical result.

mike-ops: Noted. Two hypotheses: (1) card-level merchant blocking (company policy blocking \"software subscription\" category), or (2) issuer temporary block/velocity. Did customer try another card?

sophie: They said other personal cards succeeded. Only the company card fails. Billing descriptor is \"Redwood Inference - SUBSCRIPTION\" which may map to 'software services' merchant category.

jamie-payments: Can we check merchant category code mapping for that descriptor? I can open a ticket with acquirer if needed. Also check our tokenization -> we send `mcc=5815`? (example).

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2787 (payments decline, company-card). Assigned to jamie-payments.

jamie-payments: I checked the gateway mapping — descriptor maps to MCC 5734 (computer software). Some corporate programs block 57xx ranges. I'll escalate to bank-liaison with the merchant descriptor + acquirer response.

bank-liaison: Looping in global-banks: please validate if Acme's T&E policy blocks MCC 57xx or if the issuing bank returned a hard decline. If hard decline, request issuer reason code.

anna-support: Action list: (1) Ask customer to confirm spend policy with their card admin. (2) Ask them to try virtual company card with higher allowed categories if available. (3) We'll attempt a follow-up charge tomorrow morning (lower velocity).

sophie: Noted — will message customer with steps and request a bank screenshot + whether their corporate card program permits software subscriptions.

mike-ops: If issuer confirms merchant category block, we should offer an invoice pay-by-bank or ACH link to avoid friction for enterprise customers.

sophie: Thanks. I'll update thread after customer's reply. :thumbsup:

(END)
